# training that makes great people

Squaricle Group is made up of several great brands, delivering training that makes truly great people.

## training solutions that create great people

We are focused on helping human to human connections.

We are a values driven business, with an absolute focus on improving people performance.

Squaricle Group is made up of several great brands, delivering training that makes truly great people.

The Group was founded in 2020 as ted Learning Group and changed its name in June 2021 to reflect the diversity of our brands and partners. Several of our brands have been trading for many years and have built up strong reputations for the services, products and solutions they provide. We created the Group as a way of combining great brands and creating a partnership route for other niche L&D offers.

We work in partnership with our clients and want to feel like an extension of your own L&D team. We spend time getting to know your business so that any product or service we provide feels completely relevant to your people.

Whatever your development needs, we have a solution for you. All of our offers are multi-channel and can be delivered via the classroom, virtual classroom or online learning.

## Our brands are ted Learning, ted HuB, emerging-u & CurioTraining

### ted Learning

ted Learning delivers both classroom-based, virtual and online learning using theatre-based learning. We use professional actors and experienced trainers and deliver any form of training that involves human interaction.

### ted HuB

The ted Learning HuB is a vibrant online learning community where our clients’ learners access their digital and virtual training, including pre and post-course work. Learners also get life-long access to free ted Express courses, podcasts, videos and the latest insights.

### emerging-u

emerging-u is a Leadership Learning and Development Agency that specialises in culture change, leadership development and team effectiveness. We create the conditions for change.

### CurioTraining

CurioTraining is our online workplace training brand. Practical, accredited courses for individuals, teams and organisations that get people ready for real work. Learn online on any device, with certificates included and easy team enrolment for managers.

## delivering a full suite of learning and people development services

Squaricle Group represents a unique mix of products and services from live drama-based learning to digital content and learning technologies.

## Page: ted Learning

Source: https://www.squariclegroup.com/ted-learning.php
Businesses and partners / ted Learning

# ted Learning is dramatically different

ted Learning was established in June 2012 to deliver theatre based learning that was dramatically different, engaging and fun.

dramatically different

engaging

fun

We never do role-play. Learners observe and direct the action, and when they interact with the actors they always play themselves. We call this real-play.

ted Learning delivers theatre based learning that is dramatically different, engaging and fun. Over the years we have worked across many sectors and industries.

Our training is experiential. We appeal to more than just the see and hear senses that most training is directed at. Because we create work based scenarios based on real life, learners feel emotionally connected to and engaged with the learning. That sense of feeling drives reactions, thoughts and discussions.

We use professionally trained actors who bring the theatre of learning to life.

ted Learning offers both classroom based learning and blended learning.

## What is theatre based learning?

Training has to be fun, to embed the learning and deliver long term benefits to your people and your organisation. At ted Learning, we use our ‘theatre of learning’ to fully engage learners with scenario based and practice sessions.

By observing human interactions in a number of different environments, we get a chance to understand why people react the way they do. This helps us learn how we can avoid conflict and how we manage different approaches depending on who we are speaking with, what it’s about and where the conversation is taking place.

### How do we do it?

Our professionally trained actors specialise in getting under the skin of your organisation so we portray real-life situations. We want everyone attending a ted Learning course to say “they get us”. Working with expert trainers and facilitators, we create safe, fun environments to learn.

If it’s not dramatically different, engaging and fun, it’s not ted Learning!

## What is blended learning?

Blended learning can either begin before a classroom based intervention, after the session or be both before and after.

The team at ted Learning can work with you to ensure that, before attending a classroom based workshop, learners have some pre-work to complete. That way the face to face time is maximised for engaging learning. We can also test how the learning has been embedded with follow up assessment or feedback.

## Why work with ted Learning?

2012

ted Learning has been in business since 2012.

10,000+

learners have received training from ted Learning.

98%

rated their experience as good or excellent.

We only deliver bespoke training. Every course we run has been created around a framework but is adapted specifically for your organisation and learners.

Learners often comment how realistic the scenarios were and that we get their business. We are trusted to deliver great training and are passionate about learner engagement.

## Our 5 steps to learning

At ted Learning we always follow 5 steps when working with any new client.

- dnaWe get to know your business by spending some time either in it or conducting an extensive process with you.
- createWe then create bespoke and relevant training.
- experienceNothing beats a fun, engaging training experience and that’s what we deliver.
- how was it?We ask for immediate feedback and follow up suggestions after the training event.
- what’s next?We want to embed the learning, which we do via blended learning or digital learning to extend past the classroom based experience.

## we are here to help you

Still unsure about working with us? Our FAQ might help, or visit our website at www.tedlearning.co.uk.

Who do you work with?+

ted Learning works across all sectors and industries. From manufacturing, retail, insurance, hospitality, financial, travel, tech to local authority and housing associations. We pride ourselves on the depth of organisations we work with, from small teams to delivering large conferences to over 500 employees.

What makes ted Learning different?+

Learning should be engaging and fun. ted Learning delivers dramatically different, engaging and fun. People laugh but learn. Our actors deliver realistic scenarios that ensure people feel the learning as well as seeing and hearing it. And our expert trainers are experienced in their subject matter: if they deliver project management, they have been a project manager in the past. If they deliver customer service training, they have worked in a customer service environment.

## you’re in good company.

# emerging-u

Leadership Learning & Development Agency

We create the conditions for change.

We believe in a world where people are able to connect through shared purpose and meaning.

A world where individuals and teams are empowered to be their best and flourish in any situation.

A world where human connection is the key energy source for businesses and individuals to thrive.

## leadership

How leaders show up for the people they serve directly impacts how those people serve their leaders, each other and your customers.

We create the conditions for leaders to release their best selves, inspire their people and shape the future.

## teams

High performing teams hold a shared vision, understand the pathways to achieving that vision and are deeply committed to the realisation of that vision.

We create the conditions for the teams to connect deeply, collaborate effectively and innovate collectively.

## CX

In business, human connection is the critical element of success. How we engage with our customers determines our tomorrows.

We create the condition for your people to connect to your brand’s values, embody them, own them and deliver exceptional customer experience every time.

Our people / our team

# our team

Our team are a group of hugely talented, passionate and dedicated individuals, some of whom have worked together for years, others who are more recent additions to the Squaricle Group family.

Some of our people work across the Group, others work specifically for one of our fantastic brands.

All of us work collaboratively, the embodiment of our One Team value, to deliver exceptional results for our clients.

## leadership team

### Justin Smith-Essex

Founder & Group CEO

Justin is the Group CEO of Squaricle Group Limited and one of the co-founders and Managing Director of ted Learning.

Justin works across the Group to support each brand in delivering against their business plan and vision. He is passionate about engaging learning and the use of drama to put people on the receiving end of an experience. He leads on our partnership discussions and managing the relationship with our stakeholders.

### Roxy Hooton

Director of Operations: Brands, People & Quality

Roxy is the Director of Operations: Brands, People & Quality for Squaricle Group, overseeing each of the brands’ product development, our People/HR functions and the quality of all of our products, regardless of how they are delivered to our customers.

She is a fundamental part of our team ensuring that our people are looked after and that our delivery is tailored to the clients’ needs and, from a quality perspective, is ‘on-brand’. She is responsible for overseeing recruitment of all trainers and actors and is part of both the main Group Board and Operations Board.

With a background in fashion retail management and learning & development, she has been managing teams and designing and delivering skills-based learning for over 20 years. Roxy has worked with ted Learning for over 6 years and really gets the brand and the need to ensure all of our learners are excited and engaged by their experience with us. In a previous role, she was also completely responsible for developing the entire curriculum and learning that OFSTED recognised as Good.

## Louisa Castledine

### Client & Learning Partner

Louisa is our Client & Learning Partner for ted Apprenticeships. She has worked in education since graduating from University, with a Degree in Theatre Arts. She uses performance skills to keep learners engaged and entertained throughout the sessions! She doesn’t do the acting though, she has the ted professional actors for that!

Having worked in Apprenticeships for over 10 years, Louisa has held delivery, curriculum and quality roles. This provides a wealth of knowledge and experience when working with prestigious clients to upskill their workforce, and support individuals to achieve their goals.

## Laurence Davies

### Head of Creative

Laurence is our Head of Creative at Squaricle Group. He is responsible for ensuring each brand’s look and feel is delivered in all the materials we produce and supporting all parts of the business in ensuring the essence and language is on brand.

He is obsessed with food and loves to travel and taste different cuisines.

## Michelle Boardman

### Head of Online

Michelle is our Head of Online Learning at Squaricle Group. She works internally with the team when designing classroom/virtual sessions on how we digitise the product.

She also works with our clients to translate their learning needs into digital wonderment! Michelle is LEGO obsessed and any chance to get some, takes it!

## Ben Sammon

### Multimedia Producer

Ben is the Multimedia Producer at Squaricle Group with his focus being on creating fun, engaging and interactive online content that reflects the nature of our brands.

He has the responsibility of turning our scripts into something that looks fantastic on various media platforms and specialises in creating animated content. Ben is also in his own band and loves making super creative objects!

## Jane Taylor

### Group Planning Manager

Jane is our People Planning Manager and an integral part of the team. She supports with the booking of the trainers and actors for all our workshops across all brands within Squaricle Group. She makes sure that all of our clients are looked after by providing feedback summaries after all of our workshops.

Jane is also the first point of contact for all of our trainers, actors, learners and clients dealing with the many enquiries they may have.

## Luisza Banzagale

### Graphic Designer

Luisza is our Graphic Designer and a valued member of the ted Learning creative team, based in our Philippines office. She creates and produces our social media content, from eye-catching graphics to visuals that support our marketing campaigns.

Working closely with our Head of Creative, Luisza helps keep our visual identity consistent across social media and other creative projects. Much of her work happens behind the scenes, turning creative ideas into finished designs that make ted Learning instantly recognisable.

## Erwin Taborda

### Online Learning Specialist

Erwin works behind the scenes with Michelle to create our ted e-learning courses, building our digital learning products for both the ted Learning HuB and client platforms.

He transforms our dramatically different, engaging and fun live training into interactive digital modules. With a sharp eye for detail and a passion for accessible learning, Erwin makes sure every course keeps the energy and interactivity of the ted Learning experience.

## Joy Aluning

### Customer Relationship Manager

Joy is our Customer Relationship Manager at ted Learning. She manages client data as it enters the business, making sure it is accurately recorded and organised so the team can communicate effectively with clients.

Joy also produces and distributes our monthly newsletters, keeping clients and subscribers up to date with our news and training opportunities. Her attention to detail keeps our records tidy and our newsletters landing in the right inboxes!

## Johanna Malicad

### Finance & Contracts Manager

Johanna is a valued part-time member of the ted Learning team, working from our Philippines office. With years of experience in financial accountancy, she manages our day-to-day accounting, including invoicing, reconciling accounts and keeping accurate financial records.

Johanna also supports the onboarding of new clients, issuing contracts and making sure ted Learning is correctly set up as a supplier. She plays a vital role in keeping us financially on track and, perhaps most importantly, stopping us from spending too much money!

# our values

Squaricle Group has a clear set of values that are embedded into everything we do.

Alongside our mission statement, we ensure that everyone who works for Squaricle Group Limited lives and breathes these values. This ensures we have an organisation that is also internally focused on the same elements we spend our time training our clients and learners on.

## our mission

[Mission statement to be added. The current website refers to “our mission statement” but does not show one.]

## One Team

We will always work collaboratively with our clients to create an inclusive environment so that they feel we are working as one team.

Everyone at Squaricle Group is part of One Team, regardless of which brand they work for.

We will always work proactively to build positive, effective relationships based on trust and mutual respect whilst appreciating individual preferences, strengths and areas for development. We will always work hard to overcome the geographical barriers presented by being part of a remote team and delivering to clients all over the UK. We are open to giving and receiving supportive, constructive feedback that both celebrates success and aids ongoing development.

## Commercial Success

We will always deliver great value for money, demonstrable return on investment and ensure both businesses are commercially successful.

We will ensure we always deliver value for money for our clients and learners. We will ensure we operate a commercially successful business for the benefit of our clients, learners, employees and stakeholders. We will always concentrate on expansion of our product range to constantly meet our clients’ and learners’ changing needs. We will focus on the diversification of the types of training and how we deliver this to enable growth.

## Innovative

We will always do things differently by being innovative, creative and through our shared wisdom.

We will always challenge the way we work and seek to be more innovative than our competitors in what and how we deliver our products.

We are comfortable collaborating with our clients and a broad range of our team to seek new ideas, fostering a culture of creativity and continuous improvement. We take feedback on board and use it to innovate and grow. We are prepared to take considered risks to enhance the learning experience whilst being mindful to deliver on the agreed outcomes.

To find out how we can inspire your leaders and managers to achieve their potential for themselves and for your business, please get in touch.

Our values / diversity & inclusion

# diversity & inclusion

## our commitment

Squaricle Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse culture.

We deliver inclusion and training and believe passionately in the fundamentals of having a team that represents all parts of the community and that embraces inclusion. We strive to give all of our team equality of opportunity.

Squaricle Group is dedicated to encouraging a supportive and inclusive culture amongst our entire team. Our aim is to ensure that all team members and job applicants are given equal opportunity and that our organisation is representative of all sections of society. Each team member will be respected and valued and able to give their best as a result.

This policy reinforces our commitment to provide equality and fairness to all in our employment and not provide less favourable facilities or treatment on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ethnic origin, nationality, national origin, religion or belief, or sex and sexual orientation. We are opposed to all forms of unlawful and unfair discrimination.

All team members, no matter if they are part-time, full-time or temporary, will be treated fairly and with respect. When Squaricle Group Limited selects candidates for employment, promotion, training or any other benefit it will be on the basis of their aptitude and ability.

## our goal

- To create a culture and environment in which individual differences and the contributions of all team members are recognised and valued.
- To create a working environment that promotes dignity and respect for every employee.
- To not tolerate any form of intimidation, bullying or harassment and to take action against anyone who breaches this policy.
- To make training and development and progression opportunities available to all staff.
- To promote equality in the workplace, which Squaricle Group Limited believes is good management practice and makes sound business sense.

## how

- We will ensure we have a culture and environment that encourages anyone who feels they have been subject to discrimination to raise their concerns so we can apply whatever corrective measures are needed.
- We will regularly discuss our values and ensure they are embedded into our culture. We will always treat people with dignity and respect.
- We will regularly review all of our employment practices and procedures so that fairness is maintained at all times.
- We will ensure the Group Board is regularly trained and aware of the latest legislation and leads from the front in creating a positive and inclusive culture.
- We will provide independent access to anyone who needs it should they have concerns with a member of the Group Board.

## talk to Squaricle Group

To find out how we can inspire your leaders and managers to achieve their potential for themselves and for your business, please get in touch.

# people

## People Principles

We know that our people are our biggest and most important asset, and the key to our success.

That’s why we work hard to create a fun, collaborative, inclusive culture and environment where our people thrive, enabling individual and organisational success.

Our People Strategy is based on three fundamentals that form the context for everything relating to the Squaricle Group team:

Discover

the right people for the right roles in our business.

Nurture

their talent, creating sustainable value and driving growth.

Retain

them in the business to ensure our ongoing and long-term success.

All our people related policies, processes, resources and ways of working support the delivery of these fundamentals, and we’re always looking at how to improve and develop our people focus further.

Our values / corporate social responsibility

# Corporate Social Responsibility

## Our aims

We want our business to have a positive impact on the lives of our teams, customers, learners and our suppliers.

Each year, the entire team select an organisation that they want to receive a donation on their behalf. This is all part of our 12 days before Christmas and ‘ted giving back’.

Since we formed the business in 2012, we’ve always been committed to doing the right thing. We know we don’t always get it right, but we strive hard to learn from our mistakes and make sure our focus is on people, whether they work with us, learn from us or provide us with services.

Our Social Responsibility Programme has three areas of focus, with a clear commitment against each one. These commitments are delivered through a series of projects with measurable targets. This helps us to focus on the important things and ensure we do business in a way that brings benefits to people who buy training from us, work for us or supply us.

## Giving Back

Our team are encouraged to support local communities across the UK and we give them paid time to provide assistance. We also have our annual ‘12 days before Christmas’ event, where staff nominate charities and organisations that they feel need financial support. The Board then select 12 each year and we make a donation to each on behalf of the individual that selected them, all part of ‘ted giving back’. Our team get the chance to record a video to show why they are supporting this particular cause.

## People

We are committed to creating a great place to work. Our culture and values shape how we work in our day-to-day. They are more than just words to everyone at the Squaricle Group; they were chosen by our team as vital elements which shape us and enable us to create a respectful culture.

Our team are empowered to take the path less travelled, to push boundaries and to do it all with passion and determination. Our values apply to everyone working at Squaricle Group Limited from day one. We embed them in everything we do.

## Environment

We will always strive to minimise our impact on the environment. Whether that is creating digital content for learners to engage with from home, blended learning to minimise the need for travel, or sourcing all materials we use from like-minded suppliers. Our printers, for example, are one of the UK’s most environmentally friendly and we reduce waste by only ordering from them what we need rather than being confined to minimum orders resulting in unnecessary waste. We promote our cycle to work scheme and reduce reliance on cars to use public transport. Jane, our People Planning Manager, keeps us in check when it comes to recycling too!

## talk to Squaricle Group

To find out how we can inspire your leaders and managers to achieve their potential for themselves and for your business, please get in touch.

# careers

Why join our family?

Squaricle Group is all about our people. We want a team of talented and empowered people that can help us deliver our vision.

Our team are passionate about working at Squaricle Group. We love bringing in new talent, to challenge our ways of working, bring new skills and perspectives and add real value to our organisation.

## The benefits of working at the Squaricle Group

To do this we want to attract, engage and develop a team of diverse, creative and empowered individuals that reflects the whole UK, our clients and our learners.

We recognise that we currently don’t represent our Black and Asian communities and so we’d particularly welcome applications from people from these groups. We’re based in a variety of different locations across the country, yet we work exceptionally well together, so wherever you’re based in the UK, we’d love to hear from you.

As well as being part of a creative and innovative team, we are also pleased to offer all of these employee benefits if you join our team.

Flexible working hours

25 days starting holiday (FT)

Social events

Contributory pension

Cycle to work scheme

Fun working environment
